channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Charles Swindoll — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-14
item.description: “Life is 10% what happens to you and 90% how you react to it.” — Charles Swindoll

item.title: W. B. Yeats — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-13
item.description: “Think where man's glory most begins and ends, and say my glory was I had such friends.” — W. B. Yeats

item.title: W. Clement Stone — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-12
item.description: “When you discover your mission, you will feel its demand. It will fill you with enthusiasm and a burning desire to get to work on it.” — W. Clement Stone

item.title: Plato — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-11
item.description: “Rhetoric, it seems, is a producer of persuasion for belief, not for instruction in the matter of right and wrong.” — Plato

item.title: Albert Camus — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-10
item.description: “One must imagine Sisyphus happy.” — Albert Camus

item.title: Swami Vivekananda — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-09
item.description: “They alone live who live for others, the rest are more dead than alive.” — Swami Vivekananda

item.title: Mark Twain — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-08
item.description: “The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.” — Mark Twain

item.title: Lao Tzu — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-07
item.description: “At the center of your being you have the answer; you know who you are and you know what you want.” — Lao Tzu
